📋 Travel Programs

Travel Programs in China

Ready-made and customized programs – 7, 10 and 15 days including accommodation, tours and Arabic-speaking guide

📋 3 Ready Programs⏱️ 7 min read
Home◂Tourism in China◂Travel Programs

Arcadia Tourism offers comprehensive travel programs in China to suit all tastes and budgets. Whether you're traveling with family, friends or individually, you'll find the right program with us. All our programs include accommodation in selected hotels, Arabic-speaking guide, transportation, and entrance tickets.

Classic Program – 7 Days 🌟

Beijing and Shanghai

The ideal program for first-time visitors to China. Includes visiting the most important tourist attractions in Beijing (Great Wall, Forbidden City, Temple of Heaven) and Shanghai (The Bund, Pearl Tower, Yuyuan Gardens). Travel between the two cities by high-speed train (4.5 hours). Price starts from $850 per person including accommodation and tours.

Comprehensive Program – 10 Days ⭐

Beijing – Xi'an – Shanghai

The most popular program. Adds Xi'an with its unique landmarks (Terracotta Army, Muslim Quarter, Great Mosque) to Beijing and Shanghai. Includes special experiences such as a tea ceremony and tai chi lessons. Price starts from $1,200 per person. Includes guaranteed halal meals every day.

Complete Program – 15 Days 👑

Beijing – Xi'an – Chengdu – Guilin – Shanghai

The ideal program for those who want to explore China in depth. Includes visiting the Panda Reserve in Chengdu, a river cruise in Guilin, and all the landmarks in Beijing, Xi'an and Shanghai. Unique experiences such as walking on the Great Wall and tasting Sichuan cuisine. Price starts from $1,800 per person.

Business Program – On Request 💼

Customized for businesspeople and merchants. Includes attending the Canton Fair or visiting Yiwu markets with translation and escort services, with the option of adding sightseeing days. Read more about business tourism.

⭐ What Do Our Programs Include?

4–5 star hotel accommodation, Arabic-speaking guide, transportation by high-speed trains and private cars, entrance tickets to all attractions, halal meals, visa assistance, and 24/7 support. Check detailed costs.

Customized Program ✏️

None of the ready-made programs suit you? We design a 100% custom program based on your interests, length of stay and budget. Choose the cities you want to visit and the activities that interest you, and we'll take care of the rest!
